title: Innovative high-pressure water scrubber for biogas upgrading at farm-scale using vacuum for water regeneration
geography: Farm-scale anaerobic digestion site; exact location not included in accessible abstract metadata
material_scope: Raw biogas treated by high-pressure water scrubbing with vacuum water regeneration and anisotropic packing
license: Not verified from the accessible bibliographic/abstract record; no article text redistributed
data_handling: Only discrete values stated in the abstract-level bibliographic record are transcribed. No graph digitization, inferred setpoints, or reconstructed mass balances.
limitations: The 20–40 Nm3/h farm-scale range is not GreenHub's predicted gas throughput.
Reported methane-purity threshold is not methane recovery.
The abstract reports energy consumption that can be reduced from 0.8 to 0.3 kWh/Nm3 raw biogas, but the exact reduced operating point and uncertainty are not available in the accessible record.
Abstract-reported +19% methane recovery and +14% CO2 elimination are preserved as changes; their relative-percent versus percentage-point interpretation must be verified in full text.
Do not use the values as calculation defaults or claim direct transfer to grass-derived biogas.
